note: Layout Builder Sections Config adds fields to Layout Builder's Configure-section form (show admin title with wrapper/position/colour, plus section id and CSS classes). The wrapper/position/colour DROPDOWN OPTIONS are the module's only global config: layout_builder_sections_config.settings with three newline-separated 'key|Label' string keys title_wrappers, title_positions, title_colors (config route layout_builder_sections_config.settings at /admin/config/content/layout-builder-sections-config, permission 'administer site configuration'). Per-section values are stored INSIDE each layout section's own configuration (key layout_builder_sections_config), not in a global object, and require building a Layout Builder layout to exercise. To stay safe on the shared site, medium/hard cases are grounded ONLY in the global option-list config (layout_builder_sections_config.settings); the baseline script restores the shipped option lists.

evals.prompt: In the Drupal module layout_builder_sections_config, where do I configure the list of title wrapper / position / colour options that editors can pick for a Layout Builder section title? Name the config object and route.
evals.expected_output: At /admin/config/content/layout-builder-sections-config (route layout_builder_sections_config.settings) which edits the config object layout_builder_sections_config.settings, whose keys title_wrappers, title_positions and title_colors are newline-separated key|Label lists.

evals.prompt: What extra fields does layout_builder_sections_config add to Layout Builder's 'Configure section' form?
evals.expected_output: It adds: Show section title to end users (show_admin_title checkbox), Title wrapper, Title position, Title color, an HTML ID (section_id), and a Classes textarea (section_classes, one class per line).

evals.prompt: In layout_builder_sections_config, what is the format of each entry in the title_colors / title_wrappers / title_positions settings, and where are the per-section choices (like the chosen colour or the section's CSS classes) actually stored?
evals.expected_output: Each option is one 'key|Label' pair per line (the key becomes the CSS class/value, the Label is shown to editors). The per-section choices are stored inside that section's own layout configuration under the layout_builder_sections_config key, not in a global config object.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, a custom section-title colour option has been added via layout_builder_sections_config. Inspect the live configuration and give the label (and CSS class) of the custom colour that has been added beyond the defaults.
evals.expected_output: A custom colour 'Brand' with class section-brand-title has been added: layout_builder_sections_config.settings:title_colors includes the line 'section-brand-title|Brand'.

evals.prompt: On this site an extra section-title position option has been configured in layout_builder_sections_config. Inspect the live configuration and name the custom position label (and its CSS class) that has been added.
evals.expected_output: A custom position 'Justify' with class section-justify-title has been added: layout_builder_sections_config.settings:title_positions includes 'section-justify-title|Justify'.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, using layout_builder_sections_config, add a new section-title colour option so editors can choose 'Red', emitting the CSS class section-red-title. Apply the change to the live site configuration.
evals.expected_output: layout_builder_sections_config.settings:title_colors gains a line 'section-red-title|Red' (appended to the existing key|Label list).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, using layout_builder_sections_config, add a section-title wrapper option so editors can wrap a section title in a <div> (labelled 'Div'). Apply the change to the live site configuration.
evals.expected_output: layout_builder_sections_config.settings:title_wrappers gains a line 'div|Div' (a key|Label entry whose key is div).
